subject: Request: Peregrine AI trial credit top-up + pricing carve-out (exec signoff)
messages:
From: Amina Qureshi <amina@peregrine.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Tanaka <paul.t@peregrine.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need: extra credits + short-term pricing carve-out to finish evaluation

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team here at Peregrine AI is excited about the latency profile and the KV cache behavior on long-context runs. We're close to finishing our end-to-end eval, but ran into two timing issues:

- Our generative evaluation runs consumed our initial trial bucket faster than expected (large batch of 50 long-context chains).
- Our procurement cycle for committing to a 6+ month usage plan will take ~3 more weeks.

To avoid stalling our PoC, can Redwood consider:

1) A one-time trial credit top-up of $60,000 to get us through the remainder of model tuning and end-to-end tests.
2) A temporary pricing carve-out: 18% discount on committed rates for the first 3 billing cycles if we sign a 6-month minimum within 45 days.

We believe the workload (multi-model experiments + embeddings at scale) will convert quickly once the SRE and production preflight look good. Happy to provide the usage logs; attached is a snapshot of the trial usage pattern and our SRE notes.

Can you advise what approvals are required? We're under a tight compliance review and would prefer to lock terms before month-end.

Best,
Amina Qureshi
Head of ML Ops, Peregrine AI

Attachment: trial_usage_snapshot.png (image)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Need: extra credits + short-term pricing carve-out to finish evaluation

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Peregrine's ask. TL;DR: they want $60k credit + 18% temporary carve-out (3 cycles) in exchange for a 6-month commit within 45 days.

Why I like this:
- High probability to expand: they ran cross-team PoC (search + generation + embeddings).
- Tech fit is strong; they flagged latency and token-cost as biggest blockers to production.

Risks:
- Credit size is meaningful and outside playbook for AE-level approvals.
- Discount depth (18%) is above standard promotional bands.

My recommended concession (balanced):
- $40,000 one-time trial credit top-up, conditional on a signed 6-month commit at a 15% discount for first 3 cycles.
- Add a clause: discount applies only to usage above baseline after trial credits are exhausted, and include a clawback if they terminate inside 60 days.

If you can sign off, I'll draft the email and updated SOW for legal. If not, please propose alternate carve-out. Need a decision by EOD Friday (Mar 24) to meet their deadline.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Director, GTM Engineering (on the partnerships lane)
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need: extra credits + short-term pricing carve-out to finish evaluation

Sofia / team — Thanks for the walkthrough. I agree on wanting to keep the customer moving, but we should tighten the economics. A few data points / suggestions: 

- Probability of conversion with this profile (internal comp): ~60% within 90 days if trial hits production metrics.
- $60k credit fully consumes our typical onboarding grant for a mid-enterprise PoC; $40k is more defensible but I'd prefer to land at $30k tied to measurable success criteria.

Counter-proposal (finance-friendly):
1) $30,000 trial credit top-up paid upfront.
2) 12% pricing carve-out for the first 3 cycles, conditional on a signed 6-month commitment within 30 days.
3) Marketing ask: joint case study + one technical workshop (value-add reduces pure cash concession).

If Pardot/legal OKs the contract language for a short-term clause and clawback, I can accept these terms. Otherwise, escalate to Marissa for exec signoff on Sofia's proposed $40k / 15%.

Also tagging Sean/Naomi for simple ARR math: Sean, please call out the revenue tradeoffs vs. acceleration. Naomi, any red flags on the clawback mechanics?

Rishi
VP, Commercial Strategy
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need: extra credits + short-term pricing carve-out to finish evaluation

Quick math: baseline ARR if they commit to 6 months at our midprice is ~$180k (estimated).

- Sofia's recommended concession ($40k credit + 15% x3) reduces NRR in year 1 by ~8% relative to list, but accelerates conversion window.
- Rishi's counter ($30k + 12%) reduces NRR by ~5%.

Given the strategic signal (multi-team usage + large eval compute), I'm comfortable recommending Sofia's plan if we:
1) Attach a 60-day clawback clause for voluntary termination.
2) Require a signed commitment and payment method on file within 30 days, otherwise concessions expire.

I've attached a draft pricing sheet and suggested revenue waterfall. Happy to walk through with Marissa.

Attachment: pricing_breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Sean Gallagher
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amina Qureshi <amina@peregrine.ai>, Paul Tanaka <paul.t@peregrine.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: Peregrine AI trial credit top-up + temporary pricing carve-out (see terms)

Hi Amina / Paul —

Thanks for the context and for being flexible on timing. After internal review we've approved a targeted package to keep your PoC moving forward:

- One-time trial credit top-up: $40,000 (applied to account upon SOW countersign).
- Temporary pricing carve-out: 15% discount for the first 3 billing cycles, applicable only after trial credits are exhausted.
- Conditions: signed 6-month minimum commitment within 30 days of this email, payment method on file, and a 60-day clawback clause in the event of voluntary early termination.
- Mutual commitments: a short joint technical workshop within 30 days and permission for a post-launch case study (redacted if needed).

Attached is the updated SOW and the pricing sheet. Please review; once you confirm, we'll route the SOW to legal and DocuSign and push the credits live on signature.

We appreciate Peregrine's interest in Redwood and look forward to helping you scale.

Best,
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Peregrine_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), pricing_breakdown.xlsx (updated)
